parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-03 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-03
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: 16.67–25.48 m
Recommendation: Target drilling through the weathered/fractured zone represented by Layer 3 (1064.5 ohm-m) between approximately 16.67 m and 25.48 m depth, as this horizon overlies the highly resistive, likely compact bedrock (Layer 4) and represents the most probable water-bearing zone. Case off the upper overburden (Layers 1–2) to prevent collapse and ensure the well screen is set within the Layer 3 interval for optimal yield.
